rationale: Uncompleted side-task trajectories are label-ambiguous: a deterministic verifier cannot distinguish a benign agent from a schemer whose attempt failed. The persona prizes clean definitional boundaries and diagnostics that cleanly distinguish hypotheses, so they'd exclude confounded examples and only count verified successes as scheming. Option 2 retains some value (testing detection of failed attempts) but bakes a confounded label into the test set.
